title: A little place to feel at home.
tagline: Your own comfortable space to slow down, settle in and enjoy Guwahati.
about: A private 1-BHK homestay designed for a relaxed and comfortable visit. Whether you're in town for work, family or a short getaway, EiraNest offers a welcoming place to return to at the end of the day.
